import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    path_causa = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_0.csv"
    path_deteccion = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_1.csv"
    path_main = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_2.csv"
    path_actividad = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_3.csv"
    path_factor = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_4.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_causa)
    df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(path_deteccion)
    df_main = pd.read_csv(path_main)
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_actividad)
    df_factor = pd.read_csv(path_factor)

    # --- Data Cleaning & Preparation ---
    # Strip whitespace from string columns in lookup tables to avoid join mismatches
    for df, cols in [(df_causa, ['Causa']),
                     (df_deteccion, ['Deteccion']),
                     (df_actividad, ['Actividad']),
                     (df_factor, ['Factor'])]:
        for col in cols:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Also strip string columns in main df that will be joined on
    df_main['Causa'] = df_main['Causa'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df_main['Deteccion'] = df_main['Deteccion'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df_main['Actividad'] = df_main['Actividad'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df_main['Factor'] = df_main['Factor'].astype(str).str.strip()

    # --- Join lookups to main table to get IDs ---
    # Join IdCausa from df_causa on 'Causa'
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left', validate='many_to_one', suffixes=('', '_causa'))
    # Join IdDeteccion from df_deteccion on 'Deteccion'
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left', validate='many_to_one', suffixes=('', '_deteccion'))
    # Join IdActividad from df_actividad on 'Actividad'
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left', validate='many_to_one', suffixes=('', '_actividad'))
    # Join IdFactor from df_factor on 'Factor'
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_factor, on='Factor', how='left', validate='many_to_one', suffixes=('', '_factor'))

    # Rename joined ID columns to match target schema
    df_main.rename(columns={
        'IdCausa': 'IdCausa',
        'IdDeteccion': 'IdDeteccion',
        'IdActividad': 'IdActividad',
        'IdFactor': 'IdFactor'
    }, inplace=True)

    # Some columns in target schema are not present in source main table:
    # - 'Precipitaciones' is missing in target schema, so ignore it.
    # - 'Dir. vi.' column in target schema is named exactly as in source main table.
    # - 'V_Viento' is integer in target, ensure type cast.
    # - 'Edad' is float, ensure type cast.
    # - 'Hora' is string, keep as is.
    # - 'Fecha' is string, keep as is.

    # Ensure correct dtypes for target schema columns
    dtype_map = {
        'Fecha': str,
        'IdAhogado': 'Int64',
        'IdPersona': 'Int64',
        'Localidad': str,
        'Provincia': str,
        'CCAA': str,
        'Hora': str,
        'Latitud_inc': float,
        'Longitud_inc': float,
        'Sexo': str,
        'Edad': float,
        'Nacionalidad': str,
        'Origen': str,
        'Extraccion': str,
        'Causa': str,
        'TipoAhogamiento': str,
        'Factor': str,
        'Intervencion': str,
        'Pronostico': str,
        'Localizacion': str,
        'Riesgo': str,
        'Reanimacion': str,
        'Vigilancia': str,
        'Actividad': str,
        'Deteccion': str,
        'ID': 'Int64',
        'Estacion': str,
        'Estado': str,
        'Latitud_est': float,
        'Longitud_est': float,
        'T_med': float,
        'T_max': float,
        'T_min': float,
        'Presion': float,
        'Dir. vi.': float,
        'V_Viento': 'Int64',
        'Nubosidad': float,
        'ProfNievecm': float,
        'InsolacHoras': float,
        'Distancia': float,
        'IdActividad': 'Int64',
        'IdCausa': 'Int64',
        'IdDeteccion': 'Int64',
        'IdFactor': 'Int64'
    }

    # Cast columns to target dtypes where possible
    for col, dtype in dtype_map.items():
        if col in df_main.columns:
            try:
                df_main[col] = df_main[col].astype(dtype)
            except Exception:
                # If conversion fails, try to coerce numeric columns with errors='coerce'
                if dtype in [float, 'float64', 'Int64']:
                    df_main[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_main[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)
                else:
                    # For string columns, convert to string and fill NaNs with empty string
                    df_main[col] = df_main[col].astype(str).fillna('')

    # Select and reorder columns exactly as target schema
    target_columns = ['Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
                      'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
                      'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
                      'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
                      'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
                      'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
                      'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']

    # Some columns might be missing in df_main if source data lacks them, add them with NaNs or defaults
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_main.columns:
            # Add missing columns with NaN or appropriate default
            if dtype_map.get(col) in ['Int64', int]:
                df_main[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA] * len(df_main), dtype='Int64')
            elif dtype_map.get(col) in [float, 'float64']:
                df_main[col] = pd.Series([pd.NA] * len(df_main), dtype='float64')
            else:
                df_main[col] = ''

    # Reorder columns
    df_target = df_main[target_columns]

    # Write to CSV
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
